get.description: This API lists all the layouts configured for a module.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status of the layout. The allowed values are active, inactive, and all

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The starting index number from where the layouts should be fetched

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of layouts to be fetched

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Name of the module whose layouts must be fetched. Standard values: tickets, contacts, accounts, calls, events, tasks, timeEntry, products, contracts. Custom modules are also supported.

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: ID of the department in which the layouts are configured

post.description: This API creates a new layout. To build the request body, first call getStandardLayoutFormat (GET /api/v1/layouts/standardLayoutFormat with the module) to obtain the sections and fields, then set departmentId, module, layoutName, layoutDisplayName, and isDefaultLayout.

get.description: Provides the standard layout format (sections and organization fields) for the given module. Use this response as the basis for the createLayout request body: unwrap data into sections, keep each field id and isMandatory (and allowedValues for pick lists), then set departmentId, module, layoutName, layoutDisplayName, and isDefaultLayout.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Name of the module to fetch the standard layout format for. Standard values: tickets, contacts, accounts, tasks, calls, events, timeEntry, products, contracts. Custom modules are also supported.

post.description: This API creates new Layout by cloning existing layout.

parameters.name: featureFlags
parameters.description: Optional feature flags that opt into additional response properties or behaviour. Multiple flags may be supplied as a comma-separated value.

get.description:
This api behaves as below
(i)When Query param _fileType_=_CSV_ is passed the picklist values gets downloaded in csv file with _*fieldlabel*_ as its name
(ii) When header param is not passed _empty 200_ response

parameters.name: fileType
parameters.description: Export Format in which format should be shown.This value can be @CSV@

schema.description: Export Format in which format should be shown.This value can be @CSV@

patch.description: This API updates details of an existing layout.

post.description: This api activates the deactivated Layout.
This API is to clone a field to other layouts.

patch.description: This api Associates the given profiles to the layout

get.description: This API fetches details of a layout, based on the profile of the current user.

post.description:
This API replaces the old value with the new value for the PickList field type in all existing records only.

Note: When a value that does not exist in the PickList values is provided as new value, then this API will create the new value without deleting the old one.

id.description: ID of the field in the layout. Send as a string (IDs can exceed safe integer precision).

isMandatory.description: Whether this field is mandatory in the layout

allowedValues.description: Allowed values for the field. Applicable to pick list fields.

defaultValue.description: Default value set for the field. Applicable to pick list and checkbox fields.

sortBy.description: Order in which pick list values are sorted. Accepted values: userDefined, alphabetical

isNested.description: Whether the pick list field is nested

restoreOnReplyValues.description: Values in the Status field that are set to fall back to the default value.

type.description: Data type of the field. Values include Text, Number, Percent, Decimal, Currency, Date, Date Time, Email, Phone, PickList, Website, Textarea, Checkbox, Multiselect, Boolean.

name.description: Name of the key that refers to the field.

displayLabel.description: Name of the field shown on the UI.

apiName.description: Unique read-only name of the custom field used to update the field value via API.

i18NLabel.description: Internationalized label for the field label.

maxLength.description: Maximum permissible length of the value in the field. Applicable to Text, Number, Decimal, and Currency fields.

decimalPlaces.description: Number of decimal places the value in the field can take. Applicable to Decimal and Currency fields.

roundingPrecision.description: Total number of digits in a decimal number. Applicable to Currency fields.

roundingOption.description: Option to round off decimal numbers. Values include roundOff, roundDown, roundUp, and normal.

isSystemMandatory.description: Whether a built-in field in the system is mandatory in the layout.

isRemovable.description: Whether the field can be deleted.

isEncryptedField.description: Whether the value in the field is encrypted.

layoutFieldRequestJson.description: Array of field objects in this section. Each element must be an object with 'id' (the field ID, sent as a string to preserve precision for large IDs) and 'isMandatory' (boolean).

fields.description: Array of field objects in this section. Each element must be an object with 'id' (the field ID, sent as a string to preserve precision for large IDs) and 'isMandatory' (boolean).
